title: Which route still holds authority?
description: Compare direct and shell routes under three placements of credential checks.
initialCaption: Investigator: round token; deployer: square token — inspect the routes to production.
interactionHint: Drag to inspect the open routes · scroll to zoom
fallback: A corridor guard blocks only its own route. Protecting the direct execution entrance leaves shell authority exposed; checking both entrances denies this investigator while the authorized deployer remains permitted. Each comparison starts a new r41 fixture.
